entry.author: Hamilton City Council
entry.summary:
It’s back, Hamilton!

2 hours free parking has returned to the central city, giving you more time to enjoy the things you love – from shopping to dining and everything in between.

To get your free parking, simply register your number plate at a kiosk or via the PayMyPark app.

Hear from Mayor Tim in the video on how it works and make the most of your next central city visit.

Don’t forget, no registration = no free parking 👀
